claim_text: More than 200,000 homes and businesses were without power by 10:30 a.m. local time on Sunday 16 August 2026 according to tracker poweroutage.us, including nearly two-thirds of all power customers on the Big Island.
quote: More than 200,000 homes and businesses were without power by 10:30 a.m. local time, according to the utility tracker poweroutage.us. That included nearly two-thirds of the power customers on the Big Island.
confidence_justification: Time-stamped figure from a named outage tracker, consistent with other reports in the cluster.
